ov: رشيدة (الفرنسية: Rachida) هو فلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الجزائر للمخرجة يامينا بشير شويخ وصدر في سنة 2002 وقد نال 15 جائزة دولية.
plotEn: Rachida lives and teaches in a popular neighborhood in Algiers. Like most of her countrymen, she thinks the conflict which is bleeding out her country does not affect her, until the day she is confronted by a group of terrorists that includes a former student of hers, Sofiane. The group asks her to plant a bomb in her school. When she refuses, the terrorists shoot her in cold blood. She saves her life miraculously and takes refuge in a nearby village.
